title: Validated Adaptation for Aerial Crowd Monitoring at Mass Gathering Scale: A Deployment Protocol, a Severity Law, and a Diagnostic for Label-Free Drone Crowd Counting, Toward the FIFA World Cup 2034 (Saudi Arabia)
abstract: arXiv:2608.17625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 FIFA World Cup and already operates crowd management at Hajj scale. Drone-based counting must hold accuracy on footage unlike anything in its training corpus, without labels, and must warn of dangerous inflow before a crush forms. We deliver a validated answer built on 525 controlled runs, a full-resolution corpus study, five falsification ablations, and a five-condition safety-interlock evaluation. Label-free adaptation recovers 31-49% of shift-induced error across four corruptions and five severities, with the strongest method gaining 41.8 MAE over the frozen source (95% CI [34.1, 49.6], p=7.5x10^-10, d=2.52). We establish a severity law separating methods with a constant absolute margin from the one whose margin grows, and a stability budget identifying which configuration is safe to fly. translated_title: 面向大规模人群聚集的空中人群监测的自适应验证：部署协议、严重性法则与无标签无人机人群计数的诊断方法——面向2034年国际足联世界杯（沙特阿拉伯）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17625v1 公告类型：新 摘要：沙特阿拉伯将主办2034年国际足联世界杯，并已在朝觐规模上运营人群管理。基于无人机的人群计数必须在与其训练语料不同的影像上保持准确性，且无需标签，并必须在踩踏形成前预警危险流入。我们基于525次受控运行、全分辨率语料研究、五次证伪消融实验和五条件安全联锁评估，交付了一个经过验证的答案。无标签自适应在四种损坏和五种严重性下恢复了31-49%的偏移诱导误差，最强方法在冻结源上获得了41.8 MAE的提升（95%置信区间[34.1, 49.6]，p=7.5x10^-10，d=2.52）。我们建立了一个严重性法则，将方法区分开来，其中一种方法具有恒定的绝对边际，另一种方法的边际增长，并确定了一个稳定性预算，以识别哪种配置适合飞行。在全分辨率语料上，存在真实的+48 MAE空中差距（源重训练至14.6验证MAE，即34%的改进）。
tldr: 本研究提出并验证了一种无标签无人机人群计数自适应协议，通过严重性法则和稳定性预算，在真实空中偏移下显著恢复计数精度，为2034年世界杯等大规模活动提供安全保障。
en_tdlr: This study presents and validates a label-free drone crowd counting adaptation protocol, using a severity law and stability budget to substantially recover counting accuracy under real aerial shifts, ensuring safety for mass events like the 2034 FIFA World Cup.
